lines.text: I was so caught up sketching the ocean view\nhere that I guess I missed my ship...
What are you going to do?
Hmm...\c\nI guess I’ll stay here for a while, in that case!\c\nI really like the color of the sea in Kanto anyway.
MINA: How about it, Kantonian Trainer?\nWant to try battling my Fairy-type Pokémon?
All right. Why don’t we gaze out at\nthe sea together, then?

Heh heh heh...
Then here I go!\c
You’re going to learn how great
Fairy-type Pokémon can be!

MINA: Oh! Wonderful!
You and your Pokémon, battling side by side...
Now that’s a great composition!\c
I’d love to draw a picture of you two.
MINA: I can’t go back to Alola until I defeat you.\c\nHeh. Just kidding.\nBut let’s battle again sometime.
